_note: Form presentation for pipelinq-forms-review, kept in one place: field order, the (i) help on master data fields, Nextcloud user and group pickers, language and timezone pickers with their defaults, and create-from-picker on references. Every key here is presentation (`format: user` lives on the property's own definition, so this overlay declares nothing): none constrains what a record may hold. The `x-*` keys are read by nextcloud-vue's fieldsFromSchema. OpenRegister refuses a schema whose `format` it does not list, so the group, language and timezone pickers are NOT formats here: the manifest pages ask for them through `fieldOverrides.<key>.widget`. `language` is hidden because correspondenceLanguage replaces it in the forms (NormalisePartyFormFields copies it over). Named 99-zz so it merges last.

lead.x-notes: UUID reference to the deal this task belongs to. Set automatically when the task is created from the Tasks tab on a lead — the object-list widget merges its resolved filter into the create payload, so the deal is pre-linked without the user picking it. A task may hang off a client, a request or a deal; the three are independent.
